description: This file defines the BuzzPost entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, representing a social media post with metadata, relationships to other entities like Employee, BuzzPhoto, and BuzzLink, and including ORM mapping and behavior methods.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Represents a social media post entity within OrangeHRM, including content, timestamps, and related media links.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the BuzzPost.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the BuzzPost.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the textual content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the textual content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the UTC timestamp when the post was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the UTC timestamp of the last update.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the update timestamp to the current UTC time.
